CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION find_regular_filers(target_year text)
RETURNS TABLE (
    employer_name text,
    active_months_in_year int,
    total_applications int
) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH employer_monthly AS (
        SELECT 
            e.corphandle AS employer_name,
            TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(c.recvday FROM 1 FOR 7), 'YYYY/MM') AS app_month
        FROM cases c
        JOIN employer e ON c.homefirm = e.corphandle
        WHERE SUBSTRING(c.recvday FROM 1 FOR 4) = target_year
    ),
    employer_active_months AS (
        SELECT 
            employer_name,
            COUNT(DISTINCT app_month) AS distinct_months,
            COUNT(*) AS total_applications
        FROM employer_monthly
        GROUP BY employer_name
    )
    SELECT 
        employer_name,
        distinct_months::int AS active_months_in_year,
        total_applications::int
    FROM employer_active_months
    WHERE distinct_months >= 9
    ORDER BY total_applications DESC, employer_name;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
